Planning Center Sync 0.7.0: replace a hand-made event when approving

- The Waiting for approval tab shows when the website already has a hand-made event with the same name. Ticked ones go to the Trash on approval, so the event is not listed twice.
- The hand-made event's graphic, page content and categories carry over to the Planning Center event.
- New dates of a repeating event keep the page content of the date before.
